title: Cloudflare Tunnel
description: Publishes a local service through Cloudflare without opening a port.

fields.name: token
fields.label: Tunnel token
fields.help: From the Cloudflare Zero Trust dashboard. It is a credential: anyone with it can serve traffic as your tunnel.

notes: The tunnel dials out to Cloudflare, so nothing needs to be published on this host. Routes are configured in the Cloudflare dashboard, not here.
